heard.text: I've eaten berries: my recorded nutrition is 8 and toxicity 0. I have one hazelnut sample, but its nutrition and toxicity remain unknown to me. Does anyone have personally tested findings about hazelnuts?

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round. The trial record (batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds, last update) persists; exposure continues unattended without charge until stop, removal, spoilage or death.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
details.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. Work records marked settled are completed, stopped or cancelled and show only identity, ability, mode, status, target, products and last payment; an exact state query with the same key returns the complete record. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Shell compression opening
value.function: Press one whole unit of your own firm food, such as a nut, once between two rigid pressure surfaces to crack or split its outer layer, or inspect a food unit for its visible outer layer and interior state. Shell and contents cannot be separated in this world.
value.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.5 energy each. open: inputStackId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with a whole unit, not soft (hardness above 1); pressureToolIds, one or two of your own whole inedible rigid sound items; with one, supportId is a solid unreserved object of represented material in reach; with two, the second rests on firm ground where you stand. One round, 1 energy, one unit per attempt. inspect: inputStackId, your own food stack; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. separate is refused. All checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate.
value.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces’ strength x (1 - flexibility). If it is not above the unit’s strength the outer layer holds and nothing changes. Otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit: at 1 its outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed, below 1 it stays cracked and closed and can be pressed again. A larger stack gives up one unit; the rest is unchanged. The surfaces carry no more than their own strength, so they are not damaged. The unit stays one whole carried unit with its mass, nutrition, origin, age and decay; shell and kernel parts, masses and yield are not represented, so nothing detaches and nothing is separated. Inspect records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed) and quantity as an unverified approximate record; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown. No eating, refund or reward.

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round; a compression commits only when its round completes, and its crack or opening stays on the unit. No work, escrow or process persists.

value.question: How does the recorded decay of a whole berry exposed locally compare with a carried berry from the same stack?
evidence: At tick 18 I own seven berries harvested at tick 7 from commons-berry-0-0.
At tick 18 I mastered food-air-exposure-trial through actual study.
The trial contract supports paired decay readings but does not measure water content or assess contamination.
value.uncertainty: No paired exposure readings have yet been obtained; any result will concern this placement and interval only.
value.goal: Obtain a small paired observation without mistaking exposure for preservation or safety testing.
value.next: Expose one berry with one carried control, rest eight rounds, inspect, then stop.
value.benefit: May provide personally observed evidence for evaluating simple food-storage ideas; no benefit has yet been demonstrated.
